name: Docker
description: Docker is a platform for "accelerated container application development," providing tools to build, ship, and run containerized applications with security and isolation.
best_for: Docker serves individual developers (free Personal tier) up through Pro, Team, and Business/enterprise tiers; the site states 91% of Fortune 100 companies run on Docker and 20M+ developers build on it daily.
features: Docker Hub for discovering/sharing container images
Docker Hardened Images (SLSA Level 3 patched images)
Docker Sandboxes (microVM isolation for AI agent sessions)

alternatives.name: Vercel
alternatives.description: Agentic infrastructure for deploying web apps and AI agents at global scale with Git-connected preview deploys.
alternatives.best_for: Developers and platform builders deploying apps and autonomous agent workflows.

alternatives.name: Netlify
alternatives.description: A platform to create with AI or code and deploy instantly on production infrastructure.
alternatives.best_for: Product engineers, AI developers, marketers, and designers building web apps.

cons: Docker Desktop commercial use at companies with more than 250 employees OR more than $10 million in annual revenue requires a paid subscription.
Paid plans are seat-based and some product usage has separate limits or add-ons, so plan price is not necessarily the full operating cost.
